'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch [[Drone warfare|drones]] and [[cruise missiles]] on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least 31 people and injuring more than 150 others. At least one [[tower block]] completely collapses. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-year-old-among-28-dead-thursdays-russian-attack-kyiv-2025-08-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce930z8g9mvo (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-kyiv-attack-76b7e62e44e79a6475c84ce9aaf0fbf2 (AP)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] clash with various [[Mai-Mai]] groups in several villages in the Ufamandu group, [[Masisi Territory]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2025/07/31/actualite/securite/violents-combats-entre-lafcm23-et-plusieurs-groupes-armes-locaux (Radio Okapi)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[State Administration Council|military junta]] of [[Myanmar]] formally ends the country's four-year-long [[state of emergency]] and declares a [[2025 Myanmar general election|December 2025 election]] for the country's new [[President of Myanmar|head of government]] and [[Pyidaungsu Hluttaw|legislative members]]. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-politics-election-government-min-aung-hlaing-cf6e7ff92cc92a134c9592ad39e62770 (AP)]
*[[New People's Army rebellion]]
**Eight alleged members of the [[New People's Army]] are killed in clashes with the [[Philippine Army]] in [[Las Navas, Northern Samar]], [[Philippines]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2090343/8-alleged-npas-killed-in-n-samar-days-after-marcos-zero-guerilla-remark (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Canonisation of John Henry Newman]]
**[[Pope Leo XIV]] declares [[Saint]] [[John Henry Newman]], a 19th-century [[Anglicanism|Anglican]] convert who became a prominent [[Catholic Church in England and Wales|English Catholic]] theologian, as a [[Doctor of the Church]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pope-honor-doctor-john-henry-newman-vatican-457b952840a1f979db3c6980ecf0e79e (AP)] [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-07/st-john-henry-newman-set-to-become-newest-doctor-of-the-church.html (Vatican News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The death toll from the flooding in [[Beijing]], [[China]], increases to over 70 as the government discovers 31 [[elderly people]] who were trapped in a [[nursing home]] in [[Miyun, Beijing|Miyun district]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-beijing-elderly-care-center-flooding-deaths-58d1a27ff40adcf74c38db3c2ea2c362 (AP)]
*Six people are killed and nine others are injured after a {{M|w|4.2}} earthquake causes a collapse at the [[El Teniente]] copper mine near [[Machalí]], [[O'Higgins Region]], [[Chile]]. [https://www.tiemposur.com.ar/internacionales/derrumbe-en-una-mina-de-chile (''Tiempo Sur'')]
*Heavy rain leads to [[flash flood]]ing in the [[Guinea]]n capital [[Conakry]], killing at least seven people and leaving several others missing. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20250801-heavy-rains-in-guinea-capital-conakry-cause-multiple-deaths-and-destroy-homes (RFI)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[executive order]] restoring the [[Presidential Fitness Test]] in all public schools [[United States|nationwide]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-presidential-fitness-test-schoolchildren-1e0b667df467f767df1cd1388ea29f1c (AP)] [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2025/07/31/trump-push-up-mile-run-test-school-kids/85460411007/ (''USA Today'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]], [[Liberation Day tariffs]]
**[[South Korea–United States relations]]
***[[South Korea]] and the [[United States]] reach a [[trade agreement]] that places a 15% [[tariff]] on U.S. imports from South Korea. South Korea also promises to invest US$350 billion into American [[biotech]], [[semiconductors]], and [[shipbuilding]] over an unspecified time. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250731005052315 (Yonhap)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/trump-south-korea-tariff-deal/ (CBS News)]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces revised tariff rates set to start on August 1, including a new 35% tariff on [[Canada]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/trump-issues-blitz-tariff-announcements-copper-brazil-south-korea-small-value-2025-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Slovenia relations]], [[Arms embargoes on Israel since 2023]]
**The [[Government of Slovenia|Slovenian government]] announces a complete ban on the import, export, and transit of arms and military equipment to and from [[Israel]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2610195/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[Myanmar–United States relations]]
**American [[lobbying]] firm [[DCI Group]] signs a $3 million-per-year agreement with [[Myanmar]]'s [[Ministry of Information (Myanmar)|Ministry of Information]] to provide public affairs services aimed at rebuilding relations with the United States, according to a [[Foreign Agents Registration Act]] filing, despite existing [[United States government sanctions|U.S. sanctions]] on [[Tatmadaw|Myanmar's military leadership]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/myanmar-signs-deal-with-washington-lobbyists-rebuild-us-relations-2025-08-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Faisalabad]], [[Pakistan]], sentences [[Leader of the Opposition (Pakistan)|opposition leader]] [[Omar Ayub]] and over 200 supporters of ousted [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Imran Khan]] to over ten years in prison each for their participation in the [[2023 Pakistani protests|2023 protests]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-convicted-opposition-leader-imran-khan-supporters-4bbdbe63ee06c3eac51539c3b2c704b7 (AP)]
*[[Conor McGregor]] loses his appeal against a civil court in the [[Republic of Ireland]], finding that he [[rape]]d Nikita Hand. [https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2025/0731/1526261-conor-mcgregor-court/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] [[Osama Krayem]] is found guilty at [[Stockholm District Court]], [[Sweden]], of involvement in a [[war crime]] in which [[Royal Jordanian Air Force]] pilot [[Muath al-Kasasbeh]] was burned alive inside a cage in [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]] by the [[Islamic State]] on January 3, 2015. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czd04nn7q75o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Legislative Assembly of El Salvador]] abolishes [[President of El Salvador|presidential]] term limits, increases presidential terms from 5 to 6 years, and moves the date of the [[2027 Salvadoran presidential election|next presidential election]] from 2029 to 2027. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czd04q87zryo (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Italy]] and [[Vatican City]] agree to transform a 430-hectare (1,100-acre) field in [[Rome]] to a [[solar farm]] that will power the Vatican, with the goal of turning it into the first [[carbon-neutral]] state. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-solar-farm-108aa7efecf0d094a5b00e25b6a7c737 (AP)] [https://www.bdtonline.com/news/nation_world/vatican-strikes-a-solar-deal-that-aims-to-make-it-the-world-s-first-carbon/article_b74a4fc3-cae1-5559-8218-638fb25ea642.html (''Bluefield Daily Telegraph'')]
